final_message:
The change will likely fail the hidden checks.

The edit only updates text when `customerReview.getDescriptions()` is non-empty. Reviews without an existing description entry will retain their old text, violating the requirement that editing changes both rating and text.

It also does not visibly add or alter the missing-review handling for deletion, so the required 404 behavior cannot be confirmed and may still fail.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 92
